parameters.routing_scope: one MLP substitution; original attention order; no KV cache
parameters.controller_role: predict continuation utility from live activation and geometry
parameters.controller_context: all detached nonpadding outer activations plus two shared anchor/query tokens
parameters.controller_readout: two shared head rows; unbounded margin / 4 for training

runtime.interpretation: One parameter store; shared core views add zero weight storage. Temporary activations remain separate. No offloading, quantization or second model.
runtime.concurrency_interpretation: Separate CUDA streams were used, but simultaneous GPU kernel execution was not measured/observed. Do not claim parallel-kernel speedup.
limits: One full GPU weight store; no CPU offloading or quantization. Core views add zero weight bytes, but controller activations use memory.
Peak allocation/reservation are workload-specific and distinct from total driver/display VRAM.
Short validation-batch timing with three repetitions is not a general serving throughput benchmark.
No KV cache; each generated token recomputes context. Separate execution contexts do not establish simultaneous kernel execution.

weight_preservation.scope: Exact checkpoint-value comparison, including non-core interface rows and partial-MLP complements. One selected/reference leaf at a time; bounded byte comparisons, no full model or mask allocation. Runtime storage aliasing is a separate model audit.

argv: Start with 12, add 5, then multiply by 2. Is the result A: 34 or B: 29? Reply with A or B.

goal_interpretation: The core goal is conditional improvement of the full outer model, not solo core task accuracy.
Cross-checkpoint gains include weight adaptation. Learned-vs-disabled, best-fixed and shuffled comparisons isolate inference-policy value at the selected weights.
Frozen outer 85% does not mean its outputs stay fixed: the trained core weights are also used by ordinary outer inference.
Shared GPU storage is established separately from quality; zero added parameter bytes do not imply zero controller activation memory.
This one-seed narrow-task result and unadjusted intervals do not establish general reasoning superiority.
